Mixed Feelings#000.src: Speak to Javen at the Corkus Docks.

Mixed Feelings#001.src: Mo’in lad! We don’t get many Wynn folks round ‘ere.
Mixed Feelings#001.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#002.src: Welcome to old Javen’s tavern, what can I do yer for?
Mixed Feelings#002.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#003.src: Let’s see... I can give ya some of the islands “Old Cork” Brew..
Mixed Feelings#003.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#004.src: Seems like you are in luck today, adventurer.

Mixed Feelings#005.src: My day's been long, and you also look like you could do with a drink or two.

Mixed Feelings#006.src: There's no need to pay by yourself. Javen, we'll have two cups of the seasonal brew.

Mixed Feelings#008.src: Everything alright, lad? Looking a bit pale...
Mixed Feelings#008.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#010.src: Oh by the mighty founders, everything is ruined!
Mixed Feelings#010.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#012.src: You did this! Yer mad in the head! Possessed or summet!
Mixed Feelings#012.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#013.src: Yer seem fine now though. What got inter ye lad? You went berserk like!
Mixed Feelings#013.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#014.src: It weren’t just here neither. You ran outta here and wrecked all sorts! You better go find the people you affected and apologise
Mixed Feelings#014.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#015.src: Talk to the citizens around the docks.

Mixed Feelings#016.src: The whole aqueduct is ruined! The cities fresh water is just draining into the ocean...
Mixed Feelings#016.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#017.src: Ah! It's you! Back to wreck the rest of the city's infrastructure?! You're meant to be a tourist!
Mixed Feelings#017.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#018.src: Wait... Weren't your eyes red before? Were you ill? It was a bit scary.
Mixed Feelings#018.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#019.src: Oh.. You don't even remember? Well.. If you want to help, I need it right now.
Mixed Feelings#019.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#020.src: The system needs to be rebooted, which can only be done down in the sewers.
Mixed Feelings#020.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#021.src: Kind of a design flaw if you ask me.. But if you go down that trap door, you will find it in the sewers!
Mixed Feelings#021.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#022.src: You fixed it? Everything you broke? That's one hell of a twisted personality.
Mixed Feelings#022.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#023.src: Corkus has been urging tourists and envoys from the other provinces to gain recognition.
Mixed Feelings#023.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#024.src: There are others that blame any outsiders for the problems of the islands.. They say they are patriots.. but honestly...
Mixed Feelings#024.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#025.src: They are just awful people. They want to do anything to make non Corkians look bad.
Mixed Feelings#025.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#026.src: If I were you, I'd better start asking around to find out more about that!
Mixed Feelings#026.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#027.src: Speak to the other citizens around the docks.

Mixed Feelings#028.src: It’s THEM! Someone call the authorities! It’s the one who set my house on fire.
Mixed Feelings#028.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#029.src: How could you do this and just come back all calm like? You were screaming your head off!
Mixed Feelings#029.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#030.src: My house is still burning! Wait… You say you don’t have any memory of any of this?
Mixed Feelings#030.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#031.src: Look, if you’re serious, you have a chance to help make it better.
Mixed Feelings#031.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#032.src: There are valuables in a chest in there you must save before the whole place burns to the ground, get going!
Mixed Feelings#032.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#033.src: You did it! So you weren't lying? Ugh, I guess you might just be trustworthy.
Mixed Feelings#033.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#034.src: You know about the 'patriots' of Corkus?
Mixed Feelings#034.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#035.src: Well this kind of maneuver is right up their alley.. It certainly made you look bad!
Mixed Feelings#035.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#036.src: Now that you bring it up, I did hear a group of Corkians quietly discussing something about framing tourists.
Mixed Feelings#036.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#037.src: I have no idea how they would make you do something against your will though...
Mixed Feelings#037.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#038.src: Talk to the final victim of your rampage.

Mixed Feelings#039.src: Came back to wreck the rest of my work have you? Why aren't you all insane looking?
Mixed Feelings#039.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#040.src: So now your story is you were not in control? It's easy to believe. You were mad!
Mixed Feelings#040.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#041.src: I don't know if you have some kind of condition.. but if you want to help, I need it to clean up the mess you made.
Mixed Feelings#041.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#042.src: I need to replace all the cargo you destroyed.
Mixed Feelings#042.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#043.src: All you gotta do is get those crates here and put them back on the boats. The limit is {~} for each boat, not more not less!
Mixed Feelings#043.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#044.src: Some weights might not be needed, but be careful, I don't wanna go diving after you.
Mixed Feelings#044.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#045.src: You did it? ... -I mean, at last. Eh... I guess I was too fast with my judgement for once.
Mixed Feelings#045.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#046.src: Hmm… As it happens I have seen some strange things around here.
Mixed Feelings#046.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#047.src: During the night I saw something moving across the cliffs.. Looked like a personal balloon.
Mixed Feelings#047.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#048.src: It wouldn't have been out of the ordinary except there are occasional blood trails leading from the balloon...
Mixed Feelings#048.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#049.src: If you really want to approach these people… I guess all you would need to do is follow the trail of blood.
Mixed Feelings#049.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#050.src: Can't say I recommend it but the trail starts near the aqueduct.
Mixed Feelings#050.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#051.src: Follow the trail of blood and board the airship.

Mixed Feelings#053.src: Why are you here? I don't mean here and now, I mean why are you on our island?
Mixed Feelings#053.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#054.src: You have of course found yourself in front of me because you were a pawn in our attempts to save this nation.
Mixed Feelings#054.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#055.src: I suppose I should apologize, but truth is you are the reason for this movement. Not you personally... but your people.
Mixed Feelings#055.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#056.src: You... Look at yourself. You fight in a war you did not cause. You come from a land you don't even remember.
Mixed Feelings#056.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#057.src: We ask ourselves why would we invite people from two lands of sin. Invite a nation of warring travellers and a nation of greedy merchants to our doors?
Mixed Feelings#057.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#058.src: The Corkian people are above such mundane capitalism and brutality. We work as a nation to better all.
Mixed Feelings#058.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#059.src: You have been a pawn your entire existence on this world. The worst part is you don't even know it.
Mixed Feelings#059.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#060.src: Do you, for example - Know the name of your ultimate enemy? The reason for the war on your land?
Mixed Feelings#060.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#061.src: No? Didn't think so. I have no time for this. You served your purpose, even if you did try and redeem your barbaric behaviour... Kill them!
Mixed Feelings#061.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#062.src: Fight and evade the waves of mobs until the timer runs out.

Mixed Feelings#063.src: Tougher than I expected. You don’t mind if I interfere a bit, do you?
Mixed Feelings#063.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#065.src: You may have won this fight, but you are still the loser in this situation.
Mixed Feelings#065.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#066.src: Your eyes are still closed to the greater picture of it all. Corkus is the only place safe from it. I will make sure of it!
Mixed Feelings#066.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#067.src: There are still greater things in motion as we speak. Plans that will secure this island's safety.
Mixed Feelings#067.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#068.src: Fruma.. Gavel.. Wynn… It’s all a joke. We all sit on the cusp of this reality, fighting only the prelude to the real war.
Mixed Feelings#068.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#069.src: This is our farewell. I must depart before the short sighted government arrive. Good Luck with your struggle.
Mixed Feelings#069.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#071.src: Now look who we got over ‘ere! We were all wondering if you'd ever wake up.
Mixed Feelings#071.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#072.src: Sorry we ever doubted ye. Weren't fair of us. What you drank was a rare brew designed to enrage and berserk someone.
Mixed Feelings#072.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#073.src: Basically, it weren't yer fault lad. We never knew some Corkians were so closed minded.
Mixed Feelings#073.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#074.src: Anyways! Look at what we got, thanks to you I acquired this little place!
Mixed Feelings#074.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#075.src: By means of reparations have this on me. Yer always welcome round here.
Mixed Feelings#075.speaker: Javen
